LINKTEXT: The city centre area of Glasgow was declared an Air Quality Management Area in 2004 for failure to meet the annual mean objective for NO2. In 2007 the AQMA was extended to include North St and Royston Rd and to include the annual mean PM10 objective.
The Byres Rd / Dumbarton Rd area of Glasgow was declared an Air Quality Management Area in 2007 for failure to meet the annual objective for NO2.
The Parkhead Cross area of Glasgow was declared an Air Quality Management Area in 2007 for failure to meet the annual mean objective for NO2.
